{
    "content": "<ul>\n<li>Do not use the &quot;Flatten Image&quot; option. A new layer will be created containing\nonly the border (this layer will be the active layer).</li>\n<li>Perform &quot;Layer-&gt;Transparency-&gt;Alpha to Selection&quot;</li>\n<li>Perform &quot;Layer-&gt;Delete&quot;. (you don't need this layer any more)</li>\n<li>Perform &quot;Layer-&gt;Transparency-&gt;Add Alpha Channel&quot; (if possible)</li>\n<li>Perform &quot;Edit-&gt;Clear&quot;</li>\n<li>Note: the &quot;Layer&quot; commands are also available on the context menu accessed by\nright-clicking on the layer's thumbnail preview in the Layer Dialog.</li>\n</ul>\n",
